description: This file defines the ScreenSlidePageFragment class, which extends Android's Fragment class. It manages a page in a screen slide or wizard UI, handling creation, view inflation, and passing of page number arguments.

classes.name: ScreenSlidePageFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment representing a single page in a screen slide or wizard UI, capable of displaying a page number and related title.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new ScreenSlidePageFragment with a specific page number.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and retrieves the page number from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets the title text to reflect the page number.

methods.name: getPageNumber
methods.description: Returns the page number associated with this fragment instance.
